definitions.nav: Daily net-of-fee wealth normalized to 1 at the opening close.
definitions.annual_active: Mean of daily strategy-minus-benchmark returns, multiplied by 252.
definitions.annualized_relative_return: Closing strategy-to-benchmark wealth ratio, relative to the opening ratio, compounded to 252 sessions.
definitions.tracking_error: Sample standard deviation of daily return differences times the square root of 252.
definitions.drawdown: Minimum wealth divided by the running peak minus 1, including the opening close in the peak.
definitions.turnover: Executed buy plus sell notional divided by twice the prior close strategy NAV.
definitions.daily_nav_bps: Mean daily amount divided by prior close strategy NAV, in basis points.
definitions.cumulative_cost_nav_bps: Sum of daily charged cost divided by prior close strategy NAV, in basis points.
definitions.writeoff_cny: Sum of valuation losses from marking prolonged unpriced positions to zero.
definitions.os: Final-year diagnostic on carried positions and cash, with return statistics measured from the preceding close.
definitions.calendar_periods: Calendar years and half-years clipped to the covered trading dates.

interval.method: Moving-block bootstrap percentile interval on daily paired differences
